text:
tess: Anyone up for a 10-floor stair sprint challenge at 12:15? Winner gets bragging rights and a granola bar. :muscle: 
omar: I'm down but can only make 12:30. Could we do two heats?
tess: Two heats works. Heat 1 at 12:15, Heat 2 at 12:30. Sign up with heat number.
lucy: I'll take 12:15 12:15 seems perfect between meetings.
jay: 12:30 for me, might try a hangboard finisher instead of sprinting 10 hangs at half-crimp :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
mike: Hangboard? that's intense. I'll do the stairs for cardio.
fitbot: gym-safety: please warm up for 5min before sprinting and wear ankle-support if needed. Capacity check: both heats ok.
ariel: Suggestion: quick mobility + calf stretch before the sprint. I can lead a 3-min warmup.
tess: Nice. Heat assignments so far: 12:15 12:15 1lucy, tess. 12:30 12:30 1jay, omar, mike.
omar: If I do 12:30 I'll probably swap to hangboard after 1who wants to join me?
lucy: Not today 1saving forearms for later.
ariel: I'll do hangboard with omar after the sprint. Good to pair up for spotting.
fitbot: leaderboard reminder: please DM your time or hang counts to me after the event. auto-updates on the funboard at tinyurl.com/redwood-funboard.
tess: Small prize: winner gets a sticker and a granola bar from the snack stash. Loser buys coffee? :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
jay: Loser buys coffee is a power move. I'm in.
mike: Remote: will replicate on my apartment stairs and submit time. Can someone confirm rules for remote entries?
ariel: Remote ok as long as it's the same 10-floor vertical and you send a quick video or phone timer screenshot.
fitbot: note: remote entries flagged as "remote" on leaderboard.
tess: Final checklist: 3-min warmup (ariel), shoes tied, phone timer, water. See you at the stairwell door at 12:12. :running_shoe:
